{{Quote|With the sensors blind to our ships, we should be able to sneak right down to Fresia and grab those X-wings.|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]|<ref name="EAW" />}}
'''Fresia''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] that served as headquarters for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].

==Description==
Fresia was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Fre'ji]] in the [[Fre'ji system]]<ref name="CATCW" /> of the [[Torranix sector/Legends|Torranix sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Located between [[Galand]] and [[Cal-Seti/Legends|Cal-Seti]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Agricultural Circuit]],<ref name="TEA13" /> it was a terrestrial world 10,308 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter, with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. As a result of extremely slow axial rotation, Fresia's [[Standard day/Legends|day]] lasted 528 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], while its [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 132 standard days.<ref name="CATCW" />

Fresia had seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]], which produced complex and extreme tidal cycles. The world's climate was temperate but varied wildly, with violent storms occurring often, and its mean temperature was cool. The planet featured [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], and its terrain included rocky islands and fractured archipelagoes. Fresia featured an abundance of indigenous wildlife, including the [[Coromon Headhunter/Legends|Coromon headhunter]], but [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] and [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] were rare due to the climate.<ref name="CATCW" />

The world served as the headquarters of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].<ref name="CATCW" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] brought in many nonhuman [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to work for nationalized Incom, most of whom lived on the [[Coromon Islands]].

==History==
[[File:BattleofFresia.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Battle of Fresia]].]]
Some time before [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]] Fresia made starships, namely shuttles. [[Shigar Konshi]] parent's were killed in a Fresian shuttle when a vacuum seal malfunctioned.<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>

Fresia was an uninhabited planet when investors purchased it in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occupied Fresia shortly after Incom completed the first prototypes of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Due to the high concentration of aquatic environments on Fresia, the Empire maintained a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|aquatic stormtroopers]] on the planet.<ref name="CATCW" />

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the X-wing prototypes were held there by Incom and, according to instructions by Incom, the newly-formed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] carried out an [[Battle of Fresia|operation]] in order to obtain them led by [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]. After the battle, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] wanted to liberate Fresia and rid it of Imperial control. However, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] countermanded this decision, stating that it would present too much of a target to the Empire and endanger the citizens of Fresia.<ref name="EAW" />

==Inhabitants==
Fresia lacked a native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] comprised 96% of the planet's population of 2.3 million, which made it one of the least-populated habitable Core Worlds. The exceptional length of Fresia's days and nights affected the mood of its inhabitants dramatically.<ref name="CATCW" />
